sentences.en: The more stubborn you are, the more isolated you become.
sentences.zh: 你越固执，就越会变得孤立。

sentences.en: After three days of hiking, I was isolated in Senegal.
sentences.zh: 徒步三天后，我身处塞内加尔的一个偏远地区。

sentences.en: This isolated island is rejoicing at finally having drinkable water.
sentences.zh: 这个与世隔绝的小岛终于有了可饮用水而欢庆起来。

senses.zh: 偏远的；孤立的；孤独的；单独的； 绝缘的
使……孤立；使……分离；将……剔出（isolate 的过去式和过去分词）
